verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5090 is a discrete graphics card, not a software product that holds user data and surfaces insights or suggestions from it, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. Its documented AI features are rendering technologies (DLSS frame generation, super resolution, ray reconstruction) plus Tensor Core compute for developers. These are adjacent capabilities or building blocks, not an in-product feature that analyzes the user's data and offers insights.
